primitives.assumptions: Assumes user has a verified Hugging Face account with active quota; assumes the target Space is publicly accessible and does not require authentication.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Operational failure occurs when the Space exceeds its 60-second timeout, experiences queue congestion due to low quota, or is taken offline by the owner.

layer2.mapping: Maps to the GSI conformal prediction framework where the API call serves as an empirical observation to update posterior distributions. In GSE, it functions as a lightweight state-transition trigger for audio synthesis tasks.
layer2.telemetry: Latency of the Gradio predict() call, success rate of the inference request, and the status code returned by the Space.
